title: DOM elements in egui and Qt Quick
blurb: Two native UI toolkits compiled to WebAssembly, each with real <input> and <select> elements laid out and drawn by the toolkit. Plus notes on Flutter, Compose and others.
question: Can a native UI toolkit compiled to WebAssembly (egui, Qt Quick) use real DOM inputs as widgets inside its own WebGL canvas?
result: Yes for both, with a bridge of about 200 lines and no change to the toolkit. Tab order and occlusion are left to the bridge.
